_说明: 关于页的文字（Tia 提供，原文照录）。首页“关于这个项目”用 home；关于页用 intro、me、principles。label 是段首加粗的小标题。 audioCredit：语音导览的说明，有场景上线录音之后才自动显示。

home.zh: 走进名画，是一座可以走进去的线上美术馆。在画里走一走，发现细节，听听画背后的故事，然后去博物馆看看真迹。
home.en: An online gallery you can step inside. Walk into a painting, discover its details, hear its story, then go and see the real thing.

intro.zh: 走进名画是一座可以走进去的线上美术馆。每一幅名画都被做成一个可以探索的空间：走进画里，发现细节，听它背后的故事，最后去博物馆看真迹。
intro.en: Walk into Paintings is an online gallery you can step inside. Each painting becomes a space to explore: walk in, discover details, hear the story behind it, then go and see the real thing in a museum.

intro.zh: 它不想替代原画，而是想让你更想去看原画。
intro.en: It is not meant to replace the original, but to make you want to see it.

me.zh: 我是 Tia，住在伦敦，学过电影和教育。我不是程序员。网站的代码由 AI（Anthropic 的 Claude）编写；创意、故事、文字和每一条事实，都由我撰写和核对。
me.en: I'm Tia, based in London, with a background in film studies and education. I'm not a programmer. The code is written by AI (Claude, by Anthropic); the concept, stories, texts and every fact are written and checked by me.

principles.zh: 只使用已进入公有领域的画作；每条事实都有可靠来源；解读性的内容会标明是解读；图片来源注明在每个场景中。
principles.en: only public-domain paintings; every fact has a reliable source; interpretations are marked as such; image sources are credited in each scene.

audioCredit.zh: 语音导览由 Tia 录制。
audioCredit.en: Audio guides are narrated by Tia.
